findings.description: The read callback logs the email body to stdout for every chunk.
size * nmemb can overflow size_t before std::min is applied.
If the rest of the code does not force TLS (SMTPS or STARTTLS), credentials and message content could be sent in cleartext.
If SSL verification is disabled elsewhere, it opens the door to MITM.
Not shown, but common with such code. Use environment variables or secure secret stores.
